evidence.quote: EFE: October 31, AUDIO SUMMARY (AI GENERATED) 00: 00: powerbeans Valencia (EFE) - The provisional death toll from the floods in Spain has risen to 158, of which 155 have died in the province of Valencia, another 2 in Castilla-La Mancha, and 1 more in Andalusia.
On his social media profile, Mazón announced that the Military Emergency Unit (UME) informed him that the first wave of personnel will arrive this Friday at 8:00 a.m. to work during the day.
